AI & Gemini Workflows

HERMES GSuite CLI includes native integration with Google Gemini (via the official google-genai Python SDK) to enable natural-language understanding, intelligent email summarization, draft generation, and automated schedule extraction.

Deterministic Direct Execution vs. AI Pipeline

Explicit AI Invocation Only

Standard HERMES commands (such as hermes gmail list, hermes calendar today, or hermes sheets read) execute deterministically and communicate directly with Google Workspace APIs. No data is sent to Gemini on standard commands. Gemini is only contacted when you explicitly run an hermes ai subcommand or provide an AI query.

Configuring Your Gemini API Key

To use Gemini AI features, obtain an API key from Google AI Studio and supply it using either method:

Method 1: Shell Environment Variable (Recommended)

bash
# Linux & macOS
export GEMINI_API_KEY="your-api-key-here"

# Windows PowerShell
$env:GEMINI_API_KEY = "your-api-key-here"

Method 2: Persistent Local Configuration

bash
hermes config set ai.gemini_api_key "your-api-key-here"

AI Commands Reference

1. Ask Workspace Questions (hermes ai ask)

Query your schedule, messages, or workspace context using natural English:

bash
$ hermes ai ask "What meetings do I have this afternoon?"

2. Summarize Email Threads (hermes ai summarize)

Extract concise bulleted action points from complex email threads:

bash
$ hermes ai summarize --thread 18fb9921

3. Draft Email Responses (hermes ai compose)

Draft professional replies based on email thread history:

bash
$ hermes ai compose --prompt "Politely accept the meeting invitation for Thursday at 2 PM"

4. Natural Language Scheduling (hermes calendar smart-create)

Convert conversational text into structured calendar events:

bash
$ hermes calendar smart-create "Lunch with Sarah next Tuesday at noon at Bistro 42"
✔ Event scheduled:
  Summary: Lunch with Sarah
  Location: Bistro 42
  Start: 2026-10-06 12:00 UTC
  End: 2026-10-06 13:00 UTC

Model Selection & Temperature

By default, HERMES CLI utilizes gemini-3.6-flash for optimal speed and low latency. You can customize the model name in your local config:

bash
hermes config set ai.model_name "gemini-3.6-flash"
